native_motion_requirement: New coherent character acting; original personal footage is identity input only, not a delivered shot.
blocking_capability: No direct photoreal image-to-video generator is exposed in this session. Reference stills alone do not produce the requested performance.
format_note: Planned video format only. Native still dimensions are recorded separately and are not claimed as 1080p or 4K video.

cuts.name: Entry
cuts.motion_direction: Two quiet heel-to-toe steps. Natural alternating arm swing. No camera trick substitutes for walking.

cuts.name: Attention
cuts.motion_direction: Ease to a stop; small torso/head orientation toward a sound. Hold planted support foot.

cuts.name: Cuff
cuts.motion_direction: Right fingers pinch and release left cuff. Maintain coherent wrist/finger anatomy and face identity.

cuts.name: Reaction
cuts.motion_direction: Brief light fault in the environment. Head leads a small defensive turn; body weight transfers plausibly.

cuts.name: Sidestep
cuts.motion_direction: Grounded lateral evasive step with bent knees. Cloth follows torso motion; sparks/debris move independently.

cuts.name: Recover
cuts.motion_direction: Recover from lateral stance without foot skating. Lower the shielding arm and let jacket settle.

cuts.name: Resolve
cuts.motion_direction: Controlled three-quarter upper-body settling and a small head turn toward lens. No face shape changes.

cuts.name: Eye contact
cuts.motion_direction: Subtle breathing and a natural blink; calm direct gaze. Let the live action finish before the brand cut.

cuts.name: Brand
cuts.motion_direction: Completed 3.6s crown/type reveal, restrained sheen/settling, readable hold and fade, with original stereo sting.

quality_gates: Use the same master face/hair/outfit throughout. No actor replacement.
No recorded-footage cutout, recycled scene plate or procedural mannequin final.
No body/face warps, photograph morphs or still pans presented as body motion.
Maintain natural joints, stable hands and plausible cloth attachment.
Validate planted foot contact on the visible full-body beats.
No silent duplicate/freeze-frame padding on a short source clip.
Environmental particles and camera movement must not hide broken anatomy.
Visual review and explicit delivery scope are mandatory; technical gates alone are not approval.
sound_direction: Use the exact source soundtrack from the user-confirmed main reference; original encoded AAC and decoded PCM are verified.
No replacement score, normalization, added outro sting or other-chat reference audio in the matched final.
The saved crown clip can be used as video-only under the continuous source soundtrack.
Do not truncate the slightly longer original audio tail just to force the 44.4s picture duration.
cuts_role: Previous creative proposal only; NOT frame-conformed reference cut timings.
